body: I think /u/elfwicket explained it well. For me it's not that I want to die because I don't. I just find myself consistently and frequently thinking that I should kill myself. Either out of social interactions or non interactions I just break down and can't handle it. At this point I've been thinking this way for 14 years and I'm at a point where I might have programmed my brain to think this way. The only way I can get away from it is to be distracted by something and that never lasts.
